title: Upgrade server AI Chat API protocol for Vercel compatibility
body:
Upgrades the `/api/v1/ai/chat` endpoint and service-ai infrastructure to fully support the Vercel AI Data Stream Protocol, enabling direct consumption by `@ai-sdk/react/useChat` without custom adapters.

## Changes Made

- **`VercelLLMAdapter`** — New production adapter wrapping Vercel AI SDK's `generateText`/`streamText` for any compatible model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, etc.)
- **`vercel-stream-encoder.ts`** — New utilities (`encodeStreamPart`, `encodeVercelDataStream`) to convert `AsyncIterable<TextStreamPart<ToolSet>>` into Vercel Data Stream wire-format frames (`0:` text, `9:` tool-call, `b:` tool-call-start, `c:` tool-call-delta, `a:` tool-result, `d:` finish, `e:` step-finish)
- **Dual-mode `/api/v1/ai/chat`** — Defaults to Vercel Data Stream Protocol (SSE); falls back to JSON when `stream: false`. Accepts Vercel useChat flat body format (`system`/`systemPrompt`, `model`, `temperature`, `maxTokens` as top-level fields) alongside the legacy `{ messages, options }` format
- **`RouteResponse.vercelDataStream`** — New flag for HTTP server layer to encode events using Vercel frame-format SSE instead of generic `data:` lines
- **Message validation** — Now accepts both string content (legacy) and Vercel multi-part array content
- **CHANGELOG.md** — Updated with migration notes for the Data Stream Protocol upgrade

## Testing

- 176 tests passing across 5 test files (18 new tests added)
- New `vercel-stream-encoder.test.ts` with 13 tests covering all frame types, round-trip decode, empty streams, and tool-call flows
- Updated `ai-service.test.ts` with tests for Data Stream default mode, `systemPrompt` prepending, flat Vercel-style options, array content acceptance, and expanded content validation
- CodeQL security scan: 0 alerts
